tooling.reason: Its own pull request (tooling#79), on a branch of its own.
tooling.message:
perf(hooks): type-check once before a commit

## Intent

The pre-commit hook type-checked the app twice, which cost seconds on every commit. Git hooks must stay as fast as possible.

## Key changes

- The step for the staged files only formats them. The check that follows lints and type-checks the whole app once.
- Lint issues are no longer fixed automatically on commit. The message of a failed check says to run vp check --fix.
- The tooling's own hook does the same.
- Measured on one file: 2.1 s before, 1.0 s after for this step.

tooling.message:
test: count a failed pre-push in the plan without running the CLI

## Intent

After three merges in a row main was red: a test ran the CLI twice and took 5.1 s against the limit of 5 s.

## Key changes

- Counting a failed pre-push in the plan is its own function, which the test calls directly, in milliseconds. The timeout stays as it is.
- The end-to-end test of the failing app still covers that a failed pre-push counts at all.

fix(test): read the plan path from the template although it holds a placeholder with a space

## Intent

main of apps was red, and so was the check of every pull request there, including a listing pull request. The plan template now keeps the first plan at .vibe/plans/01-<short name>.md, and the test's pattern stopped at the space in the placeholder.

## Key changes

- The pattern reads up to the end of the path. Against the current template it finds .vibe/plans/01-first-version.md.

## Dependencies and side effects

- Unblocks open listing pull requests once their check runs again.
